label: Preference-independent epistemic reason from a constitutive aim
description: Conditional analyst argument, attribution deferred: the existing thin-to-ordinary result yields an ordinary-role reason; inside the goal-relative structure, an aim present in every supplied preference alternative gives that reason force at each one. In Lean the constitutive aim is only that every supplied preference satisfies the aim, indistinguishable from universal desire for accuracy. It secures the target by excluding indifferent profiles from the comparison class, not by giving an indifferent subject a reason; it is no support for the indifference case. Nonvacuity witness in the finite controls. Establishes no premise.
